$description: Cross-platform semantic design tokens for Valgate mobile apps (SwiftUI now, Android Compose later). Values are derived from apps/web/tokens.json, apps/web/DESIGN.md, and apps/web/styles/theme.css — those remain canonical for exact web color math; this file translates the same semantic intent into a portable mobile contract. Typography pixel sizes and native interaction mechanics are intentionally excluded: platforms implement type using native Dynamic-Type-equivalent scalable text and own their own interaction/feedback mechanics. See VALGATE-MOBILE-DESIGN.md for the full ownership split and component specification that consumes these tokens.

color.$description: Semantic color roles only — never bind a component directly to a hex value. Each role is defined once per mode (light/dark); consuming platforms select the active mode from the OS appearance setting.

elevated.$description: Elevated surface (sheets, popovers) — paired with elevation.level1+ rather than a distinct tint in the web source. Source: --surface-elevated.

sunken.$description: Inset/recessed surface (e.g. segmented control track). Source: --surface-sunken.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind modals/sheets — apply with reduced opacity (~0.4-0.6), never opaque, so underlying content stays legible. Source: --surface-overlay.

tint.$description: Blue-tinted neutral for hover/selection washes and subtle brand surfaces. Source: --surface-tint.

inverse.$description: Text on filled brand/dark surfaces. Source: --text-inverse.

linkHover.$description: Source: --text-link-hover; on touch platforms apply on press, not hover.

interactive.$description: Source: apps/web/styles/theme.css :root interactive-* custom properties. Web defines default+hover only; mobile has no mouse hover, so 'hover' doubles as the press/selected feedback color. Additional native press feedback (scale/opacity) is a platform interaction concern, not a token — see VALGATE-MOBILE-DESIGN.md ownership split.

hover.$description: Source: --interactive-primary-hover; use as the pressed/selected state on touch.

disabledSurface.$description: Derived (not a literal web token): reuses border-subtle as the disabled fill, matching the web app's muted-surface disabled convention.

hover.$description: Source: --interactive-secondary-hover; use as pressed/selected on touch.

subtle.$description: Subtle brand tint for badges, highlights, and the AI/premium opaque fallback accent. Source: --brand-subtle.

status.$description: Each status role carries base/background/border/text so color is never the only signal (pair with an icon or label). Source: apps/web/styles/theme.css :root status-* custom properties.

transparency.$description: The ONLY three roles permitted to use translucency/blur. Every role ships an opaqueFallback pair to render when the OS 'Reduce Transparency' setting is on — that fallback is mandatory, not optional. See VALGATE-MOBILE-DESIGN.md for usage rules.

mapOverlay.$description: Floating controls/badges rendered directly over map imagery (recenter button, pin cluster count, property callout chip). Source: --glass-icon-btn-fill / --glass-icon-btn-border / --glass-nav-item-fill / --glass-nav-item-border.

contextual.$description: Transient, dismissible surfaces anchored to a trigger: popovers, quick-action menus, tooltips, contextual sheets. Not for persistent screen chrome. Source: --glass-panel-fill / --glass-panel-border.

aiPremium.$description: The AI Hub / premium-feature surface only. Flat approximation of the layered gradient glass shell (gradients/radial tints are a decorative component detail, not a token value). Source: .ai-glass-shell base fill/border.

overlay.$description: Source: .dark --surface-overlay; apply with reduced opacity, never opaque.

linkHover.$description: Source: .dark --text-link-hover; apply on press on touch.

hover.$description: Source: .dark --interactive-secondary-hover — identical to default in the web source; on touch, rely on a native press overlay (opacity/scale) for feedback rather than a color change.

spacing.$description: 4px base scale. Treat the unit as density-independent (pt on iOS, dp on Android), not raw device pixels. Source: apps/web/tokens.json spacing + apps/web/DESIGN.md layout scale.

4.$description: Default padding / standard screen edge inset.

5.$description: Default rhythm between page content groups (web gap-5).

radius.$description: Source: apps/web/tokens.json rounded.* / apps/web/DESIGN.md Shapes section.

md.$description: Core/default radius — buttons and compact controls. Source: --radius (0.375rem).

xl.$description: Large surfaces where a bigger radius is warranted.

full.$description: Inferred, not a literal web token: fully-round pill shape for filters/tags/compact status, per DESIGN.md's 'pills are reserved for filters, tags, and compact state' guidance.

elevation.$description: Border-first depth model: prefer surface + border.subtle/default over shadow (see apps/web/DESIGN.md Elevation & Depth — 'do not nest cards inside cards', 'prefer border over decorative shadow'). Use level1 for a resting card, level2 only for a genuinely raised/actionable element, level3 only for overlays/sheets/modals or the AI premium surface.

level0.$description: Flat — border only, no shadow. Default for cards and rows.

level1.$description: Subtle resting elevation. Source: .ai-glass-divider-h box-shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)), the clearest documented light+dark small-shadow pair in theme.css.

level2.$description: Raised/active elevation for a genuinely actionable, lifted element. Source: .auth-google-btn:hover / .auth-submit-btn:hover box-shadow (0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)).

level3.$description: Overlay/modal/AI-premium elevation. Source: .ai-glass-shell box-shadow outer-depth layers.

level2.$description: ESTIMATED — theme.css does not define a dark-mode counterpart for .auth-google-btn/.auth-submit-btn hover shadow. Alpha scaled from the light value (0.08) using the same ~2.5-3x light-to-dark ratio observed at level1 (0.04 -> 0.2), rounded to 0.3 for legibility. Flagged as an uncertain mapping — verify against a real dark-mode raised control before treating as final.

motion.$description: Purposeful, non-decorative motion only (apps/web/DESIGN.md: 'keep motion purposeful: state feedback or transition only'). Never animate layout properties; animate opacity/transform. Source durations/easing are the documented transition rules in apps/web/styles/theme.css.

base.$description: Default interactive transition (border, background, shadow). Source: .auth-submit-btn / .ai-glass-input transitions.

standard.$description: Generic 'ease' transitions used throughout theme.css for color/shadow/border changes.

emphasized.$description: Decelerated easing for button/press transform feedback. Source: .auth-google-btn / .auth-submit-btn transform transitions.

entrance.$description: Panel/sheet/dialog entrance choreography. Source: auth-panel-in / auth-fade-up keyframe animations.

duration.$description: When the platform's reduce-motion accessibility setting is on, collapse every motion duration to effectively-instant rather than removing the state transition outright. Source: theme.css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum interactive hit-area sizes. Unit is density-independent (pt on iOS, dp on Android).

minimum.$description: Apple HIG floor. Matches web's touch-44 utility (44x44 CSS px) and apps/web/DESIGN.md's stated touch-target minimum.

comfortable.$description: Not present in apps/web/tokens.json — included for cross-platform consistency: Android's Material Design minimum touch target is 48dp, and the existing apps/ios DesignSystem already uses 48pt as its 'comfortable' tier (ValgateTouchTarget.comfortable). Flagged as a cross-referenced, not web-sourced, value.
